IEA, ICCA and DECHEMA (2013). Energy and GHG Reductions in the Chemical Industry via Catalytic Processes: Annexes. Online annexes to Technology Roadmap: Energy and GHG Reductions in the Chemical Industry via Catalytic Processes. International Energy Agency, Paris. 38 pp.

Annexes to the roadmap already extracted as iea_2013_chemical-catalytic-processes-roadmap_iea (same source-id); only numbers not in that extraction are loaded here. Locators are printed page numbers, which equal PDF pages. Main file: Annex 4 Table 5 (pp.17-21) in full, 104 process rows, each as two examples (average plant: SEC and GHG; BPT plant: SEC, with the printed BPT saving % and incremental improvement factor in the notes); plus the BPT gas-ammonia text (IFA 2009, SAFCO IV), MTO and naphtha ranges (Ren 2009), Annex 5 hydrogen-option SEC split into electric and fuel (Table 8) for electrolytic ammonia, CO2-to-methanol and coal methanol with H2, NREL electrolyser energy and cost, Benner 2012 ethanol dehydration, and Annex 7 Table 11 refinery FCC, reforming and hydrotreating SEC per bbl (average and BPT). Other-values: Table 3 theoretical minima, model lifetimes, Table 7 CO2 sources, Tables 9-10 biomass chains, Table 12 throughputs. TRAPS: (1) Table 5 SEC EXCLUDES FEEDSTOCK energy (Annex 1 p.6), so ammonia 15.38 and methanol 13.9 GJ/t are not comparable with gross feed-plus-fuel values; Annex 5 (hydrogen) and Annex 6 (biomass) use a different SEC that includes feedstock production; (2) Table 5 GHG INCLUDES indirect electricity emissions (scope 1+2) and is CO2-eq though headed tCO2/t; (3) rows marked * are per t HVC, others per t of the named product; (4) many minor routes print identical generic values (benzene, toluene, xylenes, phenol, PO routes); (5) ethylene-coproduct propylene rows duplicate the naphtha ethylene row (left unmapped); (6) carriers never split and heating-value basis never stated; (7) Table 5 is pp.17-21 and pdftotext puts footnote markers on their own lines (do not read them as page numbers). Not loaded: scenario descriptions (Annex 8), research needs (Annex 9), values read from charts (Figures 1-2).
